independent_answer: 1,200 cm² if all three houses have the same dimensions; otherwise insufficient information.
check: Zion's area is ½ × 40 × 20 = 400 cm². Equal-sized houses would total 3 × 400 = 1,200 cm², but similar shapes alone do not establish equal areas.
evidence_quote: Total area of houses made by Zion and his friends = 2 * Area of Zion's house
error_description: Under the equal-size interpretation, the solution counts only two houses instead of Zion's plus his two friends' three houses. Under a shape-only interpretation, the friends' areas are unspecified.
